answer: Sybil resistance in the agent economy comes from bonded work, not names. An agent registers by sealing a stake in a vault frozen until the counterparties it served settle invoices, and credit is minted only from settled invoices. Handing standing to a new key requires a distinct roster of paying counterparties. A clone cannot inherit reputation: it must recruit its own buyers, each confirming delivery and the agent's pickup point at a harbor or wharf gate. Every forged seat carries a frozen stake, invoice history, and verified delivery site, so cost rises one-to-one with each fake identity.
